business_summary: Handcrafted Italian leather handbags made to fit, sourced from Florence and priced around $1,200 with a 6-week shipping time.

relevant_tags.why: Handbags are a fashion accessory closely related to apparel shopping.

note_signals.why: Older affluent women with high AOV who respond to quality messaging align with a $1,200 luxury handbag.
Highest-AOV apparel publisher with a conservative brand sensibility fits a luxury Florence leather product.
Instant delivery and high-frequency impulse buyers conflict with custom-made, 6-week shipping luxury goods.

gate_reason: Product, price point, and fulfillment timelines are clear enough to plan targeting, though target gender and exact margin are missing.
clarifying_questions: What is your target gender audience (women, men, or unisex)?
What is your average profit margin for these handbags?
